title: Root was Built by Love, Broken by Destiny
description: Codeforces problem CF2127D - Root was Built by Love, Broken by Destiny
expected_approach: Check that the graph is a tree, no vertex has ≥3 non-leaf neighbors; strip all leaves—if nothing remains: answer = 2; if one node remains: answer = 2*(n-1)!; if two nodes u,v remain: answer = 4*(du-1)!*(dv-1)!; otherwise (path of length ≥3): answer = 4 * product over remaining vertices of (leaf-count)!.

test_cases.explanation: Tree with one central non-leaf path of length ≥3; leaf arrangement: result = 8.
Star: one non-leaf remains after stripping leaves, so answer = 2*(n-1)! = 2*3! = 12.
